# SoraRadioGroup

A labelled group of radios bound to one typed value.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | inputs |
| Import | `import { SoraRadioGroup } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraRadioGroup from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraRadioGroup'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/inputs/SoraRadioGroup.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/inputs/SoraRadioGroup.vue) |
| Generic | `T extends string \| number` |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` **(required)** | `readonly SoraOption<TValue>[]` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Group label, rendered as the `<legend>`. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Helper text below the control, announced as its description. |
| `error` | `string \| readonly string[] \| null` |  | Error message(s). A non-empty value also marks the control invalid and is announced with it. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field as required: the native `required` attribute plus a decorative marker on the label. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid`) without showing a message. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `orientation` | `SoraOrientation` | `'vertical'` | Layout direction. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Native `name` that groups the radios. Generated when omitted. |
| `controlAttrs` | `SoraControlAttrs` |  | Applied to every native radio; `ref` is called once per radio. |

## Exposed

Available on a template ref of the component.

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus` | method | Focus the selected radio, or the first enabled one. |

## Attributes

The `<fieldset>` root. `controlAttrs` is applied to every native radio.

## Keyboard

- Arrow keys move and select within the group; Tab enters and leaves it (native radio behaviour).

## Accessibility

- `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>` and native radios that share one `name`.
- `required` is set on the radios, which is how a required radio group is exposed natively.

## Styling

- `.sora-field`, `.sora-field__label`, `.sora-field__hint`, `.sora-field__error`
- `.sora-option-list`, `.sora-check[data-kind="radio"]`
- `data-orientation`
